links.outcome: Whether methylation classifier output, used with integrated diagnosis, changed final diagnosis
links.effect: Methylation results led to revision of the initial integrated diagnosis in 15 of 256 cases (5.8%); 26 truly discordant cases (CS>0.9, 10%); 36 (14%) non-contributory.
links.quote: However, its results must always be interpreted in conjunction with clinical, radiological, histopathological, and other molecular data.

unlisted_practices: Integrating DNA methylation classifier output with histomolecular integrated diagnosis and expert review of discordant cases

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world diagnostic contribution and concordance of an AI-based DNA methylation classifier (Heidelberg classifier) implemented in clinical CNS tumor diagnostics.
